sqlite-local-db.description: Allows direct querying, auditing, and editing of SQLite schema and nested dynamic table JSON entries.

gcs-storage-precontratti.description: Enables inspection, upload, and verification of master .docx/.xlsx templates and compiled PDF outputs in Google Cloud Storage.

playwright-ui-tester.description: Powers headless browser automation, E2E functional testing, and segment-based role simulation on the admin panel dashboard.

libreoffice-docker-sandbox.description: Provides an execution sandbox with LibreOffice pre-installed to test and compile real Tagged PDF/UA files locally.

gcp-cloud-logging.description: Enables querying of GCP Cloud Logging entries to debug asynchronous document compilation workers and API router exceptions.
